name: Rayo Vallecano
notes: Owner Raul Martin Presa since 2011 faces sustained fan protests; stadium closed by regional government Jul-Sep 2026 for safety failures; Bukaneros left-wing anti-fascist ultras; 2014 club and players paid rent for an evicted neighbour; 2026 Conference League runners-up.

name: Reading
notes: Rob Couhig (US, Redwood Holdings) owner since May 2025 after EFL disqualified Dai Yongge, whose era brought points deductions 2021-24; Mr Vegas online casino shirt sponsor; women's team withdrew from Women's Championship 2024.

name: Real Betis
notes: Playing at La Cartuja 2025-28 while Villamarin is rebuilt; SAD with dispersed shareholders led by Angel Haro; organised ultra fights 2023-25, UEFA fine and away-ticket ban 2025, Nov 2025 derby brawl; EUR 242k 2025 fines for offensive/intolerant chants; Forever Green sustainability platform.

name: Real Madrid
notes: Member-owned, president Perez unopposed since 2013, Nov 2025 plan to sell 5-10% of a subsidiary; last Super League backer, settled with UEFA Feb 2026; three UEFA discrimination sanctions 2025-26 (incl. Nazi salutes) plus racist abuse of Lamine Yamal 2024; Emirates (Dubai state airline) shirt sponsor; Ultras Sur banned 2013.

name: Real Salt Lake
notes: Miller family (local, ex-Utah Jazz owners) bought control April 2025, David Blitzer minority; MLS franchise; sister club Utah Royals (NWSL); ex-owner Dell Loy Hansen sold after 2020 racist-language allegations.

name: Real Sociedad
notes: SAD with broad local shareholder base, president Jokin Aperribay; members voted 86% against betting sponsors in 2018; Zubieta academy; Copa del Rey 2026 with 10 homegrown players.

name: Red Bull New York
notes: Owned by Red Bull GmbH since 2006 (secondary club in the Red Bull network with Salzburg and Leipzig), named after the owner's product; founded as MetroStars; Garden State Ultras banned 2021; 2023 supporter walkout.

name: Rennes
notes: Owned by the Pinault family's Artemis since 1998; Winamax (betting) premium partner on the back of the shirt; homophobic chants in Oct 2023 Nantes derby heard by LFP commission; stand closures for pyrotechnics.

name: Rhode Island FC
notes: USL Championship expansion club (first season 2024) owned by Brett Johnson and Michael Parkhurst; new Centreville Bank Stadium in Pawtucket 2025.

name: Rochdale
notes: Local Ogden family invested about GBP 2m in May 2024 when the club faced liquidation; fans resisted a hostile 2021 Morton House takeover; promoted back to the EFL in 2026.

name: Roma
notes: Friedkin Group (US) owns about 96% since 2020 and also owns Everton (Pursuit Sports); Eurobet.live betting shirt sponsor, Riyadh Season sponsor 2023-25; ultras attacked police before Apr 2025 derby (24 officers hurt, away ban), 2023 motorway brawl with Napoli fans, 2014 death of Ciro Esposito; UEFA settlement agreement under FFP; missing-children transfer-video campaign.

name: Rotherham United
notes: Local chairman Tony Stewart since 2008, built the club's own stadium; Rotherham Hospice charity on front of shirt 2025-27; relegated to League Two 2026.

name: SC Freiburg
notes: SC Freiburg e.V., member-owned and stable; social and sustainability focus; no betting or arms sponsors; first European final 2026 (Europa League).

name: SC Paderborn
notes: SC Paderborn 07 e.V. under 50+1; past reliance on late president Wilfried Finke and recent financial difficulties; promoted 2026 via play-off; local sponsors only.

name: SV Elversberg
notes: Member club under 50+1 but its rise is financed by the Holzer family and their company Ursapharm (shirt and stadium brands); village club in first Bundesliga season 2026-27.

name: Sabah
notes: Founded 2017, backed by Yagub Huseynov's Bridge Group construction company, not state-owned; Aug 2026 President Aliyev granted the club AZN 5m from the President's Reserve Fund after UCL qualification; Azerbaijan is authoritarian.

name: Sacramento Republic FC
notes: Majority owned by the Wilton Rancheria tribal nation since Nov 2024 (Kevin Nagle minority); USL franchise; privately financed 20,000+ seat Railyards stadium for 2028; Sky River Casino (owner's casino) is a partner, no sportsbook; no women's team found.

name: Salford City
notes: Consortium of nine shareholders led by David Beckham, Gary Neville, Declan Kelly and Lord Mervyn Davies since May 2025 (Peter Lim bought out 2024; Dream Sports Group a shareholder); losses funded far beyond natural income.

name: San Antonio FC
notes: Owned by Spurs Sports & Entertainment (NBA San Antonio Spurs parent); USL franchise founded 2016 replacing the NASL Scorpions; 2022 USL Championship title.

name: San Diego FC
notes: Owned by Mohamed Mansour (ex-Egyptian transport minister) with the Sycuan Band of the Kumeyaay Nation; secondary club in the Right to Dream network (FC Nordsjaelland); homophobic chant at Feb 2025 opener met by 'Aqui No' campaign; two stand brawls in 2025, 33 people banned.

name: San Jose Earthquakes
notes: Owned by John Fisher (Athletics owner, moving that team to Las Vegas), club for sale since June 2025; original team moved to Houston in 2006 and the club was revived in 2008.

name: Sassuolo
notes: Owned by Mapei S.p.A. (Squinzi family), owner is also main sponsor; plays at Mapei Stadium in Reggio Emilia outside its home town since 2013.

name: Schalke 04
notes: FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V. fully member-controlled, financed via members' cooperative Auf Schalke eG; debt about EUR 162m; Merkur Group (casino operator, Merkur Bets) exclusive partner to 2027.

name: Seattle Sounders FC
notes: Adrian Hanauer majority with Jody Allen and local families; members' Alliance Council gives season-ticket holders a formal voice; owns NWSL Seattle Reign; Emerald Queen Casino (tribal, with sportsbook) sleeve sponsor; plays in NFL Lumen Field; owner confronted players over 2025 prize-money protest.

name: Sevilla
notes: Years of shareholder infighting; May 2026 agreement to sell about 80% to Five Eleven Capital (fund fronted by Sergio Ramos), pending approval; supporters' trust holds a small stake; UEFA racism fine 2022; Nov 2025 derby brawl with Betis radicals (proposed one-month closure); kept Rafa Mir under contract after 2024 sexual-assault arrest.

name: Shakhtar Donetsk
notes: Owned since 1996 by oligarch Rinat Akhmetov (SCM), ex-Party of Regions MP; in exile from Donetsk since 2014 (Arena Lviv since 2023, UCL games in London 2026-27); 'Heart of Azovstal' USD 25m pledge for Mariupol defenders 2023.

name: Shamrock Rovers
notes: Members Club owns 50% and elects four directors (Ray Wilson 25%, Dermot Desmond 25%, Desmond also Celtic's majority shareholder); 400 Club supporters rescued the club from examinership 2005; NetBet sleeve sponsor; homeless for two decades after 1987 sale of Milltown.

name: Sheffield United
notes: Bought Dec 2024 by COH Sports (Steven Rosen, Helmy Eltoukhy, US); High Court wound up COH Sports Bidco Aug 2026 over GBP 35m+ purchase debt owed to previous Saudi owner Prince Abdullah; started 2024-25 on -2 points; Midnite betting shirt sponsor; Maddy Cusack welfare case.

name: Sheffield Wednesday
notes: Chansiri era ended in administration Oct 2025 (18 points deducted), earlier 2020-21 deduction; US investor group Steel City Sports Fund LP ('Arise Capital Partners', David Storch) bought club May 2026; FA fine 2024 for fans' racist chanting at Coventry; fan boycotts and protests against Chansiri.

name: Shrewsbury Town
notes: Roland Wycherley owner since 1996; sale to a US consortium led by Scott Davidson (majority owner of Edinburgh club Spartans) announced Sept 2026, completion pending.

name: Slavia Prague
notes: Czech billionaire Pavel Tykac owner since Dec 2023 (Chinese CEFC/CITIC/Sinobo 2015-23); UEFA racism sanction Feb 2025 and Kudela's 10-match ban for racist abuse of Glen Kamara 2021; repeated UEFA fines and stand closure for pyro/objects 2023-24; Fortuna (betting) stadium naming sponsor.

name: Slovan Bratislava
notes: Owned and chaired by Slovak businessman Ivan Kmotrik; far-right nationalist ultra scene with repeated UEFA racism sanctions (2014, 2019 closed doors, 2022 at Ferencvaros); UEFA away-ticket bans 2022 and 2024 for fan disorder.

name: Southampton
notes: Sport Republic (investment vehicle financed by Dragan Solak) owns 80% since 2022, also owns Goztepe and Valenciennes; Spygate May 2026 (spied on three opponents' training): expelled from play-off final and 4-point deduction for 2026-27.

name: Sporting CP
notes: Members' club (about 179,000 members) owns 88% of the SAD, elected president Frederico Varandas; Betano betting shirt sponsor to 2029; UEFA away-ticket ban 2026 and stand closure 2025 for Juventude Leonina pyro/objects; 2018 Alcochete ultra attack on players.

name: Sporting JAX
notes: Jacksonville club owned by Ricky Caplin with Tim Tebow and Fred Taylor; women's team in USL Super League since 2025, men's USL Championship debut 2026 at UNF's Hodges Stadium; 15,000-seat stadium planned for 2028.

name: Sporting Kansas City
notes: MLS founding member (Kansas City Wiz, Lamar Hunt); Peter Mallouk (local investor) took 80% in Jan 2026; The Cauldron supporters' section with long sellout streak.

name: St. Louis CITY SC
notes: Owned by the local Taylor family (Enterprise) and Carolyn Kindle, first female-majority owned MLS club; privately built downtown stadium; restricted BLM and trans-rights banners in supporters' end from Feb 2026; FanDuel sportsbook market-access partner (not shirt).

name: Stevenage
notes: Phil Wallace owns 91% and has chaired the club for decades; founded 1976 after Stevenage Athletic went bust; Xsolla shirt sponsor.

name: Stockport County
notes: Local businessman Mark Stott owner since Jan 2020, also owns Debrecen; fans' Supporters' Co-operative owned the club 2005-10; council bought Edgeley Park in 2015 to save it.

name: Stoke City
notes: Owned by the local Coates family since 2006, who own bet365, which is shirt sponsor since 2012 and stadium name; Stoke City Community Trust.

name: Strasbourg
notes: BlueCo (majority-backed by Clearlake Capital, Chelsea's owner) owns the club since 2023; Strasbourg and Chelsea fans protested jointly in March 2026 against feeder-club model; Winamax betting main sponsor; anti-fascist Ultra Boys 90; re-founded after 2011 liquidation.

name: Sunderland
notes: Kyril Louis-Dreyfus 64%, Juan Sartori 36%; Shuffle (crypto casino/sportsbook) sleeve partner, W88 betting front 2025-26; owners exploring a sale via Moelis 2026; Foundation of Light education charity.

name: Swansea City
notes: Controlled since Nov 2024 by Americans Andy Coleman, Brett Cravatt, Nigel Morris and Jason Cohen (minority Luka Modric, Snoop Dogg); Supporters' Trust holds about 7% with board seat; fans saved the club 2001-02; also 10 Welsh Cups (not counted in cups).

name: Swindon Town
notes: Australian businessman Clem Morfuni with co-owners; County Ground bought 2023 via joint venture with Trust STFC giving fans a stake; demoted in 1990 for financial irregularities.

name: TSG Hoffenheim
notes: Village club lifted to the Bundesliga by Dietmar Hopp's funding; formally returned to 50+1 in Nov 2024, but 2025-26 power struggle (Hopp backing agent Roger Wittmann) led to dismissals, labour-court cases and fan protests; SAP front sponsor.

name: Tampa Bay Rowdies
notes: Bought in 2025 by Patrick Zalupski's group as part of the Tampa Bay Rays sale; USL club reviving the NASL Rowdies name; plays at city-owned Al Lang Stadium.

name: Torino
notes: Urbano Cairo owner since 2005, long-running fan protests over lack of ambition; Nov 2024 derby-eve brawl with Juventus ultras; women's team is a separate club; Grande Torino and 1949 Superga disaster heritage.

name: Toronto FC
notes: Owned by MLSE, becoming 100% owned by Rogers Communications (2025-26); MLS franchise; 2017 domestic treble; supporter group Inebriati stripped of status after 2018 arson incident.

name: Tottenham Hotspur
notes: ENIC (Lewis family trust) owns about 88%, Levy left 2025; signed 2021 Super League and withdrew within two days; FA fine 2025 for homophobic chanting and UEFA fine 2026 for fans' Nazi salutes; among highest ticket prices in England; Bentancur 7-match ban for racial remark about Son 2024.

name: Toulouse
notes: RedBird Capital Partners (PE) owns 85% since 2020, secondary to AC Milan in its network; Winamax betting sponsor on the back of the shirt.

name: Tranmere Rovers
notes: Mark and Nicola Palios owners since 2014, seeking a sale (exclusivity with investors reported as Ascent Capital Partners, Jan 2026); reported GBP 2.9m losses.

name: Troyes
notes: Owned by City Football Group since 2020 (majority Abu Dhabi United Group, Sheikh Mansour), used as development club; Etihad Airways (UAE state airline) main sponsor; current club founded 1986 after the old Troyes club folded.

name: Udinese
notes: Pozzo family owners since 1986 (also Watford), 2025 reports of a sale to Guggenheim Partners unconfirmed; club-owned Stadio Friuli; shirt sponsor 'Io sono Friuli Venezia Giulia' is the regional government's promotional brand.

name: Union Berlin
notes: 1. FC Union Berlin e.V., member-owned, fans hold stadium shares; fans donated blood (2004) and volunteered to rebuild the stadium (2008); fan banned for antisemitic abuse v Maccabi Haifa 2021; lighter thrown at Bochum goalkeeper Dec 2024 cost a points loss; EUR 340,000 DFB pyro fine 2026.

name: Union Saint-Gilloise
notes: Alex Muzio (ex-Starlizard consultant) majority owner since 2023; Tony Bloom (Starlizard betting syndicate, Brighton owner) keeps a minority stake with shared recruitment data; National Lottery (state lottery) main sponsor; anti-fascist, anti-racist fan identity.

name: Valencia
notes: Peter Lim (Meriton Holdings, Singapore) majority owner since 2014, club debt around EUR 600m, sustained mass fan protests (Libertad VCF); racist abuse of Vinicius Jr May 2023 led to criminal convictions and partial stand closure; kept selecting Rafa Mir after 2024 sexual-assault arrest (convicted 2026).

name: Vancouver Whitecaps FC
notes: Owners Kerfoot, Luczo, Mallett, Nash put club up for sale Dec 2024, April 2026 bid proposed moving it to Las Vegas; MLS franchise tracing to 1974 NASL Whitecaps; plays in shared BC Place; criticised handling of women's-team coach misconduct (2008, 2011), supporters walkout 2019. Women's team coded as Vancouver Rise FC (Northern Super League), ownership link unverified.

name: Venezia
notes: US investor group; May 2026 minority investment by Tim Leiweke and Francesca Bodie (president) in a EUR 100m raise; plays at Stadio Penzo (1913), reached by boat; re-founded several times.

name: VfB Stuttgart
notes: e.V. holds the majority of the AG under 50+1 (Mercedes-Benz and Porsche 10.4% each); fan pressure ended the Winamax betting shirt deal early, now LBBW (state-owned regional bank); kept Atakan Karazor and made him captain despite open 2022 rape investigation.

name: Viking
notes: Norwegian member-run club; stadium partly sold to SR-Bank in the 2017-18 refinancing rescue; long-term sponsor Lyse Energi (municipally owned utility); 2025 league title first in 34 years.
